decisions.diagnosis: Near-zero counts in both directions during the February 2020 Sydney deluge are real low riding, not an outage.
decisions.evidence: Both directions fall together: 02-07 5/8, 02-08 9/14, 02-09 0/1, 02-10 44/39, then back to 94/95 on 02-11; zero_outage removed only one direction's zeros in places.

decisions.diagnosis: Low westbound counts match the equally low, unfixed eastbound counts on the same wet days.
decisions.evidence: 109 raw 2/6 vs 110 raw 3/11 (110 kept as is); both recover together 07-28 14/23 and 07-29 69/83.

decisions.diagnosis: Eastbound zeros on 2021-08-24 match westbound's 1 bike that day (kept), so the day was genuinely empty.
decisions.evidence: 08-23 46/33, 08-24 1/0, 08-25 42/29; 109 was not fixed and shows the same dip.

decisions.diagnosis: Westbound near-zero days in the early-July 2022 flood rain match the unfixed eastbound counts.
Eastbound abruptly undercounted from 2022-06-14 until a maintenance visit on 2022-07-26, after which the usual split returned.
decisions.evidence: 110/109 ratio ~0.9 through 2022-06-13 (e.g. 06-13 49/36) then ~0.45 from 06-14 (38/13, 46/20, 30/16 ...), site total fell from ~60 to ~45/day; after 07-29 ratio back to ~0.8 (Aug 32 vs 25/day).

decisions.diagnosis: Technician test hits during a maintenance visit, followed by the counter going silent.
decisions.evidence: 10:30-12:00 slots of 115, 53, 18 (109) and 12, 103, 116, 68 (110) against ~20-30 bikes per day; day totals 190/347 vs median 19/8.

decisions.diagnosis: A single midday slot of 30 during a partial outage is another test/fault artefact.
decisions.evidence: 110 at 12:45 = 30 with the rest of the day 1-2 per slot (day 40 vs ~20 typical); 109 went silent after 12:45 the same day.

summary: Single piezo counter (109) on the Ernest St shared path, 2017-2026, with gaps Oct 2021-Feb 2022 and Sep 2022-Sep 2023 (the latter already set missing by zero_outage). The main faults are an eastbound undercount from 2022-06-14 until a maintenance visit on 2022-07-26 (whose test hits are set missing), and a few rain-day zeros wrongly removed by zero_outage that are restored. The level after the Oct 2021-Feb 2022 gap is about half the 2017-2021 level and stays lower relative to Ridge St through 2024; it is left as is (possibly Warringah Freeway works or a reinstalled sensor), but trend comparisons across that gap should be treated with care.
